name: sovereign-ocr
display_name: Sovereign-OCR — Neuro-Symbolic Document Intelligence & SAP S/4HANA Engine
description: 100% air-gapped OCR, algebraic PDF CMap self-healing, 5-step geometry/DPI preprocessing, KYC/fiscal validation (CPF/CNPJ/IMEI/NF-e), active ontology grounding, and SAP S/4HANA BAPI/BPMN/DMN automation.
long_description: Official Sovereign-OCR extension for Claude Desktop (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23589075). Combines zero-copy Rust format parsers (pdf_fast, email_fast, docx_fast, xlsx_fast), algebraic PDF Type0/Identity-H CMap shift recovery, 5-step geometry & DPI-aware visual preprocessing, KYC/fiscal checksum verification, O-Laya OWL 2 RL active ontology grounding, deterministic RDF 1.2 quad provenance receipts, and SAP S/4HANA BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST / OData / BPMN 2.0 / DMN 1.3 integration. Operates 100% locally and offline with zero cloud token egress.

default_entity_code.title: Default SAP Company Code (BUKRS)
default_entity_code.description: Optional default 4-character SAP Company Code (e.g. 0010, 0040) for ontology grounding and BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST generation.

ontology_json_path.title: Active Enterprise Ontology JSON (optional)
ontology_json_path.description: Optional path to a master entity knowledge graph JSON file (vendors, payees, facility_zips) for active ontology grounding.

workspace_directory.title: Document Workspace Directory (optional)
workspace_directory.description: Optional default directory containing invoice packets, claim bundles, or PDFs.

tools.name: sovereign_ocr_doctor
tools.description: Inspect the air-gapped Sovereign-OCR runtime environment, verifying native Rust PyO3 extensions, embedded oar-ocr-cli binary, and offline GLiNER2 availability.

tools.name: sovereign_ocr_preprocess_image
tools.description: Run the 5-step geometry and DPI-aware visual preprocessing pipeline (adaptive DPI, [p1..p95] contrast stretching, interior-crop 90/180/270 orientation recovery, projection-profile deskew, and Lanczos resize).

tools.name: sovereign_ocr_repair_cmap
tools.description: Detect broken PDF Type0/Identity-H ToUnicode CMap font streams and algebraically recover shifted character streams in sub-millisecond time without pixel OCR.

tools.name: sovereign_ocr_validate_kyc_fiscal
tools.description: Classify document role (CLAIM_NOTICE_AVISO, POLICE_REPORT_BO, NOTA_FISCAL, PROOF_OF_ADDRESS, IDENTITY_DOCUMENT, PRIMARY_INVOICE) and validate CPF, CNPJ, 15-digit IMEI (Luhn), and 44-digit NF-e access keys.

tools.name: sovereign_ocr_extract_bundle
tools.description: Unpack a document file or multi-attachment bundle (.pdf, .msg, .eml, .docx, .xlsx, or image), run self-healing OCR and ontology grounding, seal an RDF 1.2 quad_fast receipt, and emit an SAP S/4HANA BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST payload.

tools.name: sovereign_ocr_build_sap_bapi
tools.description: Transform a governed extraction record into an SAP S/4HANA BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST payload, API_SUPPLIERINVOICE_PROCESS_SRV OData payload, and BPMN 2.0 gateway routing decision.

tools.name: sovereign_ocr_export_bpmn_dmn
tools.description: Export OASIS BPMN 2.0 XML and OMG DMN 1.3 XML (hitPolicy=COLLECT) for direct import into SAP Signavio Process Manager and SAP Build Process Automation (SBPA).

prompts.name: audit_sap_ap_bundle
prompts.description: Audit a commercial invoice packet or AP bundle, verify zero-balance SAP S/4HANA BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST accounting lines, and check BPMN 2.0 exception rules.
prompts.text: Call `sovereign_ocr_extract_bundle` with `target_path="${arguments.target_path}"` and `entity_code="${arguments.entity_code}"` (`include_sap_bapi=true`). Verify whether `sap_s4hana_payload.bpmn_routing.is_auto_postable` is true, confirm `BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST.zero_balance_verified`, and report the `quad_receipt_hash`.

prompts.name: triage_documentoscopia_claim
prompts.description: Triage a multi-document KYC or insurance claim dossier (Aviso de Sinistro, Boletim de Ocorrencia, DANFE/NF-e, Comprovante de Residencia, RG/CNH) with mathematical check-digit verification.
prompts.text: Call `sovereign_ocr_extract_bundle` on `target_path="${arguments.claim_dir}"` and inspect `documentoscopia_facts` (`cpfs`, `cnpjs`, `imeis`, `nfe_access_keys`, `ceps`, `rgs`, `occurrence_type`). Verify cross-document identity consistency and report any missing or corrupted artifacts.
